items.name: Southern Magnolia Wilmington Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Navy tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted Southern magnolia branch with a white bloom, hanging from a branch in a Wilmington magnolia garden, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted Southern magnolia branch, white bloom and glossy leaves, a Wilmington NC garden favorite. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Magnolia illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
